[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-gb[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]#off / #on clock tags and inherited offclock: area defaults[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Off-clock life needs no tag: an area or project note's `offclock: [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]true`, inherited down the task's root walk and overridable by a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]child's `offclock: false` or a task's `#on`, decides the clock of [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]every untagged task and Event Task beneath it; `#off` replaces [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`#offclock` as the one spelling bob writes in Obsidian and reads [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from Google Calendar; `#offclock`, `#off-clock`, and `#untracked` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]keep working while `bob gcal sync` and `bob gcal list` warn about [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]them (with a once-a-day Obsidian Notice); past Event Task rows are [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]rewritten to `#off`; and `love.md` turns on the first area default.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
